#Module abort

AbortController and AbortSignal (DOM Standard). A signal is an EventTarget ("abort"). Its reason is a (code, text) pair: AbortError by default, TimeoutError for AbortSignal.timeout(). Dependent signals (AbortSignal.any) follow their sources as the specification describes.

Exposed to: Window. Source: api/abort.widl.

Odin: import "wren:abort".

#Types

#handle AbortController : Object

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_AbortController).

#handle AbortSignal : Object

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_AbortSignal).

controller.signal

Host: AbortController_signal :: proc(c: ^Call, controller: Api_AbortController) -> u64

void AbortController_abort(AbortController controller, i64 code = 0, string reason = "")

controller.abort(reason): code 0 and an empty reason give the default AbortError.

AbortSignal AbortSignal_abort(i64 code = 0, string reason = "")

#AbortSignal_timeout

AbortSignal AbortSignal_timeout(f64 ms) raises

AbortSignal.timeout(ms): aborted with TimeoutError after ms. Range for a negative or NaN delay.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: AbortSignal_timeout :: proc(c: ^Call, ms: f64) -> (u64, Api_Error)

#AbortSignal_any

AbortSignal AbortSignal_any(AbortSignal[] signals) raises

AbortSignal.any(signals). Invalid_Handle when one is not a signal, Range past abort.max_signal_sources.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: AbortSignal_any :: proc(c: ^Call, signals: []u64) -> (u64, Api_Error)
